steps.speaker: Long-haired Man
steps.content: I'll deal with these creatures. Check on him first.
steps.female_content: I'll deal with these creatures. Check on her first.

steps.content: A paper talisman shoots past the long-haired man's shoulder, catching the creature mid-leap and nailing it to the ruined wall beyond.
Someone tugs your clothes from behind. You react before thinking and yank away.

steps.speaker: Curly-haired Young Man
steps.content: Ah!
His right hand loses its hold, but as you scramble to your feet, his left finds your free hand without missing a beat. He pulls, and you land squarely back on the makeshift cushion of his coat.

steps.speaker: Curly-haired Young Man
steps.content: ...Sorry. I've got two hands, you know.
Messy hair hides half of his face, leaving his expression a mystery. Apology or sarcasm, you honestly can't tell. In your confusion, your hands move on their own and take the water bottle from him.

steps.speaker: Curly-haired Young Man
steps.content: You're in rough shape. Take a breath. Can you still speak?
Pain throbs dully under your ribs, turning even the simplest breath into torment. Still, questions press against your tongue, demanding to be asked.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who... who are you people...

steps.speaker: Curly-haired Young Man
steps.content: Xiansheng, he doesn't remember us. His cognition may be affected.
steps.female_content: Xiansheng, she doesn't remember us. Her cognition may be affected.

steps.speaker: Curly-haired Young Man
steps.content: Maybe you should take over. I think I'm just making him mad.
steps.female_content: Maybe you should take over. I think I'm just making her mad.

steps.content: Before you can blink, Chengxiao dusts the talisman residue from his fingers with a casual shake and exhales something between a snort and a laugh.

steps.speaker: Long-haired Man
steps.content: He'll be fine.
Silence settles over everything. Only the ash of spent paper talismans drifts down like snow. The long-haired man approaches from a distance, his steps nearly soundless.

He stops before you, catches your gaze, and offers a gentle smile. Then he gestures toward your arm. You follow his eyes and notice, for the first time, the shallow red scratches running along your left forearm.

steps.speaker: Long-haired Man
steps.content: Let me patch you up first.
The curly-haired man rises without a word, giving up his spot across from you. He walks over and settles beside Lichen, who lies motionless nearby.

The long-haired man lowers himself before you. His hand lifts your injured arm with care as he pulls a cotton swab from the kit on the ground. He dips it in iodine and touches it gently near the wound, letting you feel the coolness before he begins.

steps.speaker: Long-haired Man
steps.content: My name is Lyu Buzhou. I'm a scholar on the expedition team specializing in Eastern Continent mysticism. I used to teach at the Spectral Phenomena Institute at Eastern Continent University. Though everyone here calls me Chengxiao. It's my Daoist name, and rather easier on the ears.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Daoist name... so you're a Daoist too? Then you and Lichen...

You study his clothing more carefully this time. He is Eastian, unmistakably. Yet it's his voice that snags at you, each word sounding more familiar than the last. A name almost leaps from your lips, but Chengxiao nods before you can speak it.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: That's right. That <color=#fb9259>copper coin</color> was me.

steps.speaker: Copper Coin
steps.content: Why did you stop?
Those words surface in your mind again, their intent still unclear, and reflexively you try to yank your hand away.
But he saw it coming. His hold on your wrist is calibrated perfectly: just enough to keep you there, never enough to hurt.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I scared you back there, didn't I? Forgive me. I had to say what I said to buy enough time to get you out. Had you remained in contact with her any longer, I doubt you would have lasted much past that.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Worry not. I'm nothing like that one over there, who willingly shed her flesh to go drifting about as a ghost. I'm here to bring you back.

He finishes his sentence, and only then does he slowly ease his grip, as though giving you every chance to bolt. You watch him, wary. If you had to name his expression, you'd call it earnest. That only makes it more confusing.

Still, that small flash of tension aside, he has been helping you every step of the way. You waver, then let the tension drain from your arm. A faint smile crosses his face as he returns to tending the wound.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...Just some superficial cuts. Likely from the gravel on the ground. They should heal in a day or two.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Your pallor, on the other hand, gives me far more cause for concern. Have you forgotten everything that happened before you came here?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Do you remember how you arrived in Maria City at all?
There's no honest answer you can offer, so you let him keep his assumption. Feigning memory loss seems useful. It might loosen his tongue enough to give you the answers you're after.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's... a little fuzzy...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then... how did you two end up here?
Chengxiao glances at you and smiles briefly. Your avoidance seems to roll right off him. He bows his head and goes back to the wound, explaining as he cleans.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: We had arranged for you to lead the first survey of Maria City three days ago. But you disappeared without warning just before departure, and the plan has been suspended ever since.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Leaving camp without authorization is strictly forbidden, to say nothing of entering Maria City alone. The consequences would be severe. All of this was covered in the very first safety briefing.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: You're still a child, little guide, so one could at least say you don't know any better. But a certain someone, having lived for decades, has always been far too bold for her own good. Briefings skipped, yet not a single prohibited thing left undone.
Chengxiao changes tack, his voice now lilting and theatrical, cryptic yet casual. He's clearly mimicking the way someone else speaks.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: "I'll go look for our little guide first. And while I'm at it, I can have a look around. Two birds, one stone, wouldn't you say?" Those were someone's exact words.
You raise an eyebrow and glance up. His face is deadpan, completely unreadable. Joke or not, he's giving you nothing.

steps.speaker: Curly-haired Young Man
steps.content: Professor...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: She even made you cry just a few days before departure, too. What sort of grown adult fakes their own death to tease a little kid? And so convincingly, not a single tell. No sense of where to draw the line with these things.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: The moment I suggested you might have been frightened enough to run off into Maria City, suddenly she's full of enthusiasm, going on about how she's your "big Daoist sister." So I said—

steps.speaker: Curly-haired Young Man
steps.content: Professor, your sound waves are interfering with my readings. Can the niece stories wait? Or you could walk ten meters to the left. There's a tree over there you can tell all of this to.

The Eastian man finally falls silent. You glance back and find the curly-haired young man hovering just behind you, sweeping a small, strangely shaped device around the back of your skull. It emits a rapid string of beeps.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: How's the situation?

steps.speaker: Curly-haired Young Man
steps.content: Hmm... the readings have barely stabilized, but they're not holding steady. I suspect it's caused by consciousness dissociation between the <color=#fb9259>Material Plane</color> and the <color=#fb9259>Reflection Plane</color>...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: The names Li Xianling told you would be the Realm of Yang and the Void of Yin, I imagine.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: The academic community has yet to settle on unified terminology. Only we in the Eastern Continent use those names. The Realm of Yang is simply the reality we inhabit. The Void of Yin, by contrast, is more like a separate mental plane built from human memories and obsessions.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Time and space flow erratically within the Void of Yin, and no reliable means of entry has been discovered as of yet. But Maria City appears to have been actively pulling anyone who enters it into the Void of Yin.

options: And what do you mean by "consciousness dissociation"?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: The Void of Yin and the Realm of Yang can influence one another. The deeper people's obsessions run in the Realm of Yang, the stronger the shadows grow in the Void of Yin, which in turn eats away at the mind. The reverse holds true as well. Once the corruption runs deep enough, the boundary between consciousness and body can no longer hold.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Which is precisely why I have always reminded you: <color=#fb9259>Offer no glance to the departed. Lend no ear to the abyss. Speak no question to the spirits</color>.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: In more scientific terms, the psychological hazards posed by the Void of Yin include, but are not limited to: mental disorientation, memory loss, and sensory disorder.

steps.speaker: Curly-haired Young Man
steps.content: ...Obsessive behavior.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...And obsessive behavior.
Chengxiao hesitates briefly, then murmurs his agreement in a low voice. He looks ready to steer the conversation elsewhere, but you cut in before he can begin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Obsessive behavior... So from the moment Lichen entered this city, she was already slowly turning into what she is now? Dead set on entering the Void of Yin no matter the cost...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: And now she has remained there. In a sense, she has become something that defies definition, something that has crossed beyond the boundary of life and death.

He tilts his head back and gazes at the sky. It's riddled with jagged fissures of pale green light, some wide, some thin as thread. Peering through them, you catch hazy snatches of the world within: the Void of Yin, still visible through the wounds.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: To upset the balance between two realms entirely on one's own. Well done, Li Xianling.
His eyes drop to your bandaged forearm. He gives your wrist a gentle flex, checking it over, then smooths your sleeve back into place over the wound.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: There. Do be careful on the way back, and mind you don't knock it against anything.
[Vibration Sound Effect]
The terminal Lichen left behind flickers to life, its screen glowing as a familiar symbol surfaces.
Chengxiao straightens up and scoops it from the ground in one easy motion, his fingers already moving across the display.

steps.speaker: Ziwei App
steps.content: Authorization confirmed. Switching to manual override. Retrieving backend data.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...As I thought. More and more people across the Eastern Continent are reporting strange dreams.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That thing... I wouldn't trust it too much.
An eyebrow arches on his face. He doesn't seem pleased with what you just said.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: This is a scientifically developed application built on aggregated data. It has undergone extensive safety testing.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: It is meant to provide sound guidance, steering users toward safe and controlled behavior, while intercepting any dangerous actions on their part and alerting the central database so a human operator can take over.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yeah, but just now Lichen asked it whatever she wanted and it answered, no questions asked. Forbidden arts and all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You think objects can get messed with by this city too? Same way people do?
Chengxiao drags his thumb along the rim of the screen, feeling it out. Then his mouth tightens, he locks the device with a tap, and meets your gaze with a smile.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I think I'll leave those questions for the expedition's scientists to puzzle over.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: For now, the priority is getting you out of here alive.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: There is much I'd like to ask you, once we're back.
You purse your lips and look away, sneaking a sidelong look at his face. He belongs to the same Daoist sect as Lichen... What is he trying to find out?
Not getting an answer from you, Chengxiao smiles and rises.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: No matter. We'll have enough time later.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: The researchers back at the camp have pinpointed the nearest safe zone based on the signal. Head there and rendezvous with them. I'll handle things here.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...Including the one on the ground.
While speaking, he casts a sidelong look toward Lichen's prone form.
The curly-haired man is already packed and waiting, hands resting on his bag strap, quiet at your side.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Am I going with you?
He gives a nod. Only then does it strike you: through all of this, you've never thought to ask his name.

steps.speaker: Curly-haired Young Man
steps.content: Name's Keylan. Assistant. Here to help.

steps.speaker: Keylan
steps.content: Don't worry if it doesn't ring a bell. It's a big team. Just remember the important people.
...<color=#fb9259>Keylan</color>?

[Quick flashback: an empty black-and-white piano room and one with a white figure playing, rapid color flashes with layered sound effects] [Finally settles on descriptions of him from the expedition members in the Nightmare]
A dull ache spreads through your skull. Your thoughts turn sluggish, and strange images flicker past your eyes. You desperately hold onto them before they slip away.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: ...my name isn't Mantis; I study Mantises... it's those dark flying creatures over there. That idiot <color=#fb9259>Keylan</color> calls them DisSea cockroaches...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ah, you're that guy—
The curly-haired young man flinches like he's been shocked. A painful pause stretches out before he twists toward you, lips twitching into a strained excuse for a smile, and mutters under his breath.

steps.speaker: Keylan
steps.content: Sorry. Didn't mean to drag you down to my level.

steps.speaker: Keylan
steps.content: They're Mantises... We have to remember.
The smile he wears is barely holding, but the feeling behind it reaches you before you can guard against it. Your own lips curve upward in response, even as a weight sinks slowly through your chest.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You're right. I'll remember.
You take the hand he extends and move naturally into place beside him.
...Yes, that's right. How could you ever forget someone who's walked this road with you?
